cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Save me the seat beside you at pottery. I've taken my shoes off like yours; we hardly do anything together now.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are drying by the heater. I'm only dropping you off; clay hurts my fingers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, drying first. Sit beside me anyway. You can choose the glaze and I'll do the clay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not making anything. I can stay and have a cup of tea, that's all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll have tea too. I'd rather sit beside you than take another pot home on my own.
